label: Valve
description: On/off or modulating valve with status/command/config folder structure: open/closed limit switches, optional analog position feedback, an optional travel-time fault, and a config folder holding the travel-time setpoint.

questionnaire.name: opc_server
questionnaire.description: OPC UA connection name configured in the Gateway.

questionnaire.name: device_path
questionnaire.description: OPC device path root for this valve instance, e.g. '[default]PLC1/Valves/V101'.

questionnaire.name: has_position_feedback
questionnaire.description: Does the valve report an analog position (0-100%) feedback signal, e.g. a modulating actuator?

questionnaire.name: position_eng_unit
questionnaire.description: Engineering unit for the position member (used only if has_position_feedback).

questionnaire.name: position_eng_low
questionnaire.description: Position member engineering range low (used only if has_position_feedback).

questionnaire.name: position_eng_high
questionnaire.description: Position member engineering range high (used only if has_position_feedback).

questionnaire.name: enable_position_history
questionnaire.description: Enable tag history on the position member. Deliberate opt-in per the history convention.

questionnaire.name: position_history_deadband
questionnaire.description: Historical deadband for position, in engineering units (used only if enable_position_history).

questionnaire.name: has_fault_detection
questionnaire.description: Does the actuator report a travel-time/mismatch fault (commanded but neither limit switch made)?

questionnaire.name: travel_time_setpoint
questionnaire.description: Expected full-travel time in seconds, held as a tunable config tag (not a UDT parameter, so it can be adjusted at runtime without editing the type).

tags.name: fault
tags.documentation: Valve travel-time/mismatch fault: commanded but neither limit switch made within the travel-time setpoint.

tags.name: openCmd
tags.documentation: Command to drive the valve open.

tags.name: closeCmd
tags.documentation: Command to drive the valve closed.

tags.name: config
tags.documentation: Valve tuning/configuration values, adjustable at runtime.

tags.name: travelTimeSetpoint
tags.documentation: Expected full-travel time; used by the fault-detection logic upstream of this tag.
